newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market trade poor, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market trade poor, rates flat.

text.p: Croatian money market rates held firm on Thursday morning despite very poor trade, dealers said.
"Banks' accounts were brimming with funds against marginal demand," one dealer said, putting morning deals at a mere 6.3 million kuna.
Creditors offered over 60 million kuna which found few buyers.
Call money rate was stable at 10.5 percent after easing 50 basis points on Wednesday. One-week and 30-day deals were struck at 14 and 15-16 percent, respectively.
Overnight trade totalled 2.9 million, most of which went for maintaining mandatory reserves. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
